newsitem.title: USA: Wake for Joseph Basile set for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Wake for Joseph Basile set for Thursday.

text.p: A wake for Joseph Basile, a dollar bond trader at JF Hartfield & Co, will be held beginning Thursday evening in Brooklyn.
Basile died Wednesday evening at Memorial Sloan-Kettering after a long illness.

The wake will be held from 7 p.m. to 9:30 p.m. at Ralph Aievoli & Son Funeral Home, which is located at 13th Avenue and 65th Street. Friday hours are from 2 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. and from 7 p.m. to 9:30 p.m.
A funeral mass will be held Saturday at 10:15 a.m. at Regina Pacis, located on 65th Street between 12th and 13th Avenues.
"His family lost a great dad, and the Street lost a great guy, and I lost one of my best friends," John McLean, a senior vice president at Oppenheimer & Co Inc.
Basile, 50, worked at PaineWebber Inc for about 16 years before joining New Jersey-based Hartfield a few years ago.
Survivors include his wife, Sharon; three daughters, Maria, Ashley and Amanda; and a son, Joseph.
